title: Sego Review Index Entry
x-contract-note: RATIFIED (cross-window technical ratification only). NOT Founder or user acceptance. NOT product-release approval. First recorded revision: revisions were not tracked before 2026-09-12, so each schema starts at revision 1; this marker lets a consumer pin and diff the contract source (contract changes land here, not only in the implementation).
description: Append-only index entry for .sego/reviews/index.jsonl. Each line is one ReviewIndexEntry. Aligned with Rust ReviewIndexEntry in runtime/src/code_review/report.rs. No schema_version (Codex D-B-2: index stays simple/stable). This file's root $ref targets review_index_entry, so finding_status entries validate through #/$defs/finding_status_entry.

finding_status.description: Lifecycle status of a finding (aligned with Rust ReviewFindingStatus). All six values the implementation serializes are listed; accepted_risk and false_positive were previously missing here even though they are emitted and are the two statuses that require an explanatory note.

review_index_entry.description: One index entry summarizing a persisted review.

json_path.description: Path to the full review artifact JSON.

markdown_path.description: Path to the human-readable review markdown.

finding_status_entry.description: A finding lifecycle status update (aligned with Rust ReviewFindingStatusEntry). Stored separately from the index.

note.description: Optional note explaining the status change.
